subject: c-cont
title: C.CONT.------MT.INFO.
description: First of two diagrams in PMBA-21 (Popular Music from the Black Aesthetic). The following prose names the structural target: 'There were many other factors related to the spread and dissemination of rock music in the middle to late fifties, and all of these considerations would help define the transfer-shift implications of American popular music.' The crossing diagrams how composite-continuance structurally meets multi-information at the rock-music-spread scale: C-CONT (composite continuance) crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information). C-CONT sits at top-center with the subject-arrow; POL-DY (political dynamics) at upper-left and TR-INFO (trans-information) at upper-right with P-FC (particular focus) and SG (source initiation) anchoring the upper-right margin. Three branches leave the main line. TRS (transition) at right carries TR-INFO, from whose line SG branches, with P-FC off SG's line. SOC-RT (social reality) at center-left carries POL-DY, with CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) off POL-DY's line, and RE-DOC (redocumentation), with UTZ (utilization) off RE-DOC's line. VT-PLT (vibrational platform) at right carries WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle), with AF-DY (affinity dynamics) off WO-EXP-PRI's line. MT-INFO sits at the bottom-center as partner-axis.
